name: obsidian-manager
title: Obsidian Manager
description: Ingests content from URLs, PDFs, and files into your Obsidian vault using AI
author: seanwessmith

commands.name: ingest
commands.title: Ingest to Obsidian
commands.subtitle: AI Research Assistant
commands.description: Ingest content from URL or file with customizable research modes

commands.name: batch-ingest
commands.title: Batch Ingest to Obsidian
commands.subtitle: Multiple Sources
commands.description: Ingest multiple URLs or files at once

commands.name: ingest-clipboard
commands.title: Quick Ingest from Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Clipboard URL
commands.description: Quickly ingest URL from clipboard with default settings

commands.name: research
commands.title: Research Query
commands.subtitle: AI Research
commands.description: Ask a research question and generate notes with expert-level analysis

commands.name: undo
commands.title: Undo Ingestion
commands.subtitle: Rollback Changes
commands.description: Undo recent ingestions and restore previous state

commands.name: organize
commands.title: Organize Vault
commands.subtitle: AI Organization
commands.description: Analyze and reorganize notes - rename, rewrite, or split into atomic notes

commands.name: recommend
commands.title: Vault Recommendations
commands.subtitle: Find Gaps
commands.description: Analyze your vault to find gaps, shallow areas, and missing connections

preferences.name: uvPath
preferences.title: uv Path (for YouTube)
preferences.description: Path to uv command for YouTube transcription. Leave empty to use 'uv' from PATH. Install with: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
